rows.grounds: verb indicating outward flow or diffusion
compound denoting the nectar-like essence of poetic capacity

items.question: What essence spreads forth from one possessing such poetic brilliance?
premises: Unprecedented brilliance arises at every step of expression.
The poet becomes equal to Śiva upon the earth.
A nectar-like essence of poetry flows outward from this state.
items.inference: Supreme poetic attainment naturally radiates an immortal, nectar-like poetic essence.
uncertainties: The compound kavitva+amṛta+rasaḥ may be read as either the essence of poetic nectar or poetry as nectar-essence.
items.plain_english: The nectar-essence of poetry spreads forth.
